angular-cli.description: Angular CLI MCP server – provides Angular-aware code generation, component scaffolding, migration assistance and build/lint tooling for the frontend/ workspace.

dotnet.description: dotnet MCP server – assists with .NET project management, NuGet packages, code analysis and build operations for backend/api and backend/etl-function.

mssql.description: MS SQL MCP server – enables natural-language SQL queries, schema inspection and stored-procedure execution against the Azure SQL database defined in db/.
